metadata.case_name: LAM TAI SUN v. CHOW KAM WAH

plaintiff.occupation_after: tally clerk with Lee Man Godown

injuries.description: fracture neck of the right humerus
source: On X-ray, fracture neck of the right humerus and undisplaced fracture of the right 6th rib were found.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of surgical neck of humerus

injuries.description: undisplaced fracture of the right 6th rib
source: On X-ray, fracture neck of the right humerus and undisplaced fracture of the right 6th rib were found.
The rib fracture had healed well.

injuries.description: definite muscle wasting in the deltoid region of the right shoulder joint and slightly in the upper arm
source: There is definite muscle wasting in the deltoid region of the right shoulder joint and slightly in the upper arm.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: loss in strength of the hand
source: He was diagnosed by Dr. Hodgson to have suffered a 22.5% impairment of the upper arm (due to reduced mobility of the shoulder) and a loss in strength of the hand.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

manifestations.description: mild tenderness over the right side of the face, chest and the right elbow
moderate swelling and severe tenderness of the right shoulder
constant ache in the right shoulder
inability to carry things well with his right hand which is his preferred hand
feeling tired after writing for a period of time
pain, numbness and trembling of right hand when the weather changes
definite muscle wasting in the deltoid region of the right shoulder joint and slightly in the upper arm

treatments_received: physiotherapy (one week; attended out-patient until 23rd December 1987 with out-patient card recording six visits between 24th September 1986 and 8th July 1987)
bone-setter treatment (third bone-setter: 83 visits between 9th November 1986 and 3rd February 1987; first two bone-setters: 89 visits between 12th August 1986 and 8th November 1986)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities

comparable_cases.injury_description: serious category (range of awards as adjusted between $135,000.00 to 180,000.00)

comparable_cases.injury_description: 9% impairment of the Whole Man for a Plaintiff aged 63 (award $110,000.00 in July 1987)
